name: nopal-ai-agent
description: Nopal AI Agent: Modular Autonomous AI Assistant powered by Supabase, Telegram, Gmail, and Google Gemini

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:db && npm run deploy:secrets && npm run deploy:functions
scripts.deploy:secrets: npx supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/functions/.env --project-ref pobbqgnckilmqmrpiaod
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run deploy:webhook && npm run deploy:gmail
scripts.deploy:webhook: npx supabase functions deploy telegram-webhook --project-ref pobbqgnckilmqmrpiaod
scripts.deploy:gmail: npx supabase functions deploy gmail-sync --project-ref pobbqgnckilmqmrpiaod
